title: Extract a duplicated helper across three files
prompt: src/invoice.js, src/receipt.js, and src/statement.js each contain their own copy of a money-formatting function. Extract a single exported `formatMoney(cents, currency)` into a new file src/money.js and make all three modules import and use it. Remove the duplicated local copies. Behavior must not change, and the existing tests must keep passing without modification.
